Define an ISCED-F-aligned taxonomy
10 subjects · four levels
10/40/132/236 categories by level

Collect about 40K candidate images
exams/textbooks via taxonomy Web search
plus 7 subject-knowledge datasets

Apply heuristic filters
remove duplicates · low resolution · watermarks
and non-English text

GPT-5 rates four image aspects
text richness · domain · complexity
subject-knowledge density → retain 6.5K

GPT-5 drafts exam-style prompts
create atomic yes/no scoring questions
weight each set to sum to 1

Three PhD annotators cross-validate
image · prompt · scoring points
remove duplicates and repair imprecision

Release 1,000 exam samples
10 subjects · ground-truth image
mean 74.8 words and 6.9 scoring points

Derive GenExam-Mini
level-3 stratified sampling
keep a similar full-set distribution · 487 items

Generate one image from each prompt
use each model's default T2I settings
evaluate full set or Mini

GPT-5 judge uses the reference image
answer scoring points → semantic 0–1
rate spelling/logic/readability 0–2

Report strict and relaxed scores
strict requires semantic 1
and spelling, logic, readability all 2
relaxed weights 0.7/0.1/0.1/0.1
